title: About
text: About Rob J Kennedy Rob J Kennedy is a Canberra based writer and composer whose work spans music, philosophy, the arts and technology. He has written concert reviews and music articles for Limelight and CityNews. Music has been part of Rob’s life since childhood, when he first played the flute. He has since played several instruments and is largely self taught. Progressive rock shaped his early listening and writing, before he discovered classical music and bought his first piano at 18. Today, his compositions draw on post classical music, jazz, baroque music and Russian composers, particularly Sergei Prokofiev. He is especially drawn to the expressive range of the orchestra. For Rob, music is a way of communicating what it feels like to be alive.
